community_list_entries.name: PersistBench: When Should Long-Term Memories Be Forgotten by LLMs?

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Benchmark measuring safety risks of persistent long-term memories in conversational assistants. It covers cross-domain leakage, memory-induced sycophancy, and (per repo) beneficial memory usage. 18 LLMs were evaluated. An Inspect-native implementation also exists.
